standing: Source identity for author planning only; no independent acceptance, test execution or full-file comprehension claim. Prototype source/test excerpts inspected; selected architectural sections/definitions and command/query/capability/gate registries plus inherited journal carrier inspected. The architecture.manifestPath member selects the current planning input layer. Previous layers are historical. In particular, implementation-normative-inputs.v8.json records a superseded intermediate integration state: its native-evidence.md digest matches neither frozen candidate39 nor candidate40. Its bytes are preserved as history and are not the current planning input set.
